builderPage.heroDescription: Choose a folder or ZIP archive, scan the files automatically, then fill in the mod name, version, author, and install mappings.
builderPage.heroTitle: Scan a mod source and build modx.json
builderPage.extraLinksDescription: Add more links such as mod homepages, docs, release pages, or mirrors.

builderPage.sourcePlaceholder: Choose the mod folder or ZIP archive first

builderPage.explorerDescription: Select an installed game directory, or manually specify a disk path

settings.appearanceDescription: Adjust the app theme and overall look.
settings.databaseDescription: Stores game profiles and app settings.
settings.followSystemDescription: Follows your system appearance. Current mode: {{mode}}.
settings.heroDescription: Theme, title bar, language, and storage are all managed here.
settings.homeDisplayDescription: Choose whether the game list on Home uses a card layout or a list layout by default.
settings.homeDisplayGamesDescription: Emphasize covers and game details for a more visual overview of configured games.
settings.homeDisplayModsDescription: Use a denser list that is better for scanning every game quickly and reordering them.
settings.listDisplayDescription: Manage Home and in-game list presentation together instead of splitting related options across multiple tabs.
settings.moreInfoDescription: Show time and install path on home cards.
settings.macDescription: Places window controls on the left, closer to macOS.
settings.titleBarDescription: Changing this also updates button placement and alignment.
settings.viewModeDescription: Card view highlights covers. List view is better for overview.
settings.windowsDescription: Place window controls on the right side.
settings.builderModeDescription: Choose the default file mapping interaction mode shared by the Mod Builder and Mod install preview.
settings.builderModeListDescription: Select the installation path for each file or folder directly via dropdown. Fast and direct, suitable for experienced users.
settings.builderModeTreeDescription: Archive contents on the left, game directory tree on the right. Support drag and drop across trees.
settings.builderModeExplorerDescription: Windows Explorer style interface. Click directories to navigate, support hiding source tree, and includes a preset directory drawer.
settings.workspaceDisplayDescription: Set the default information density and sort order for the Mod list in the workspace, instead of stacking more controls above the list.
settings.workspaceViewModeDetailedDescription: Show description, file count, size, import time, tags, and target folders. Better for review and troubleshooting.
settings.workspaceViewModeCompactDescription: Only show the Mod name and action buttons. Better for scanning long lists quickly.
settings.workspaceSortNewestDescription: Place the most recently imported Mods first, which is useful right after an import.
settings.workspaceSortOldestDescription: Place the oldest imported Mods first, which helps when reviewing install history.
settings.workspaceSortNameAscDescription: Sort by name from A to Z for easier alphabetical lookup.
settings.workspaceSortNameDescDescription: Sort by name from Z to A for reverse browsing.

update.apiSourceDescription: Choose whether app version checks use GTAMODX or GitHub RC first.
update.apiSourceGtmodxDescription: Requests /mods/g2m and reads data.version directly. This is the default source.
update.apiSourceGithubDescription: Requests the GitHub releases API and prefers the latest RC release.
update.availableDescription: Current version is {{currentVersion}} and a newer version {{remoteVersion}} is available. Open the download page to continue.
update.checkFailedDescription: Remote version info is unavailable right now. Try again later or switch the request API in Settings.
update.checkingDescription: Fetching remote version info and reusing your current GTAMODX login state when available.
update.description: This page shows the current version, remote version, and the source used when opening the download page.
update.downloadSourceDescription: Choose whether GitHub RC links open through the proxy or the official address.
update.downloadSourceOfficialDescription: Open the GitHub RC page directly when your network can access GitHub normally.
update.downloadSourceProxyDescription: Use gh-proxy.com in front of the GitHub RC link by default.
update.hint: Version checks are cached for one day. You can still force a refresh anytime or change the request API and download source in Settings.
update.latestDescription: Version {{version}} is still the latest result from the last successful check.
update.noticeDescription: Current {{currentVersion}}, detected {{remoteVersion}}. Open the update page to continue.
update.settingsDescription: Manage the request API and download jump source used by app updates.
update.title: Version Update

workspacePage.missingPrerequisiteDrawerDescription: Choose which missing prerequisites to install. Components without a bundled installer stay read-only here.

workspacePage.previewDrawerDescription: Review the selected mod without leaving the list.

workspaceDialogs.addDescription: Pick the game folder first, then review the detected name, type, version, and cover.
workspaceDialogs.conflictDescription: Choose how each conflict should be handled before you continue.
workspaceDialogs.coverDescription: The default cover matches the game type automatically. Custom covers will be base64-encoded and stored in the .g2m/package.json file inside the game directory.
workspaceDialogs.deleteDescription: This removes the saved game record from G2M, but it does not delete the real game files.
workspaceDialogs.deleteModDescription: This removes the mod record, its created symlinks, and the copied mod files stored in the G2M workspace for this game.
workspaceDialogs.directoryWaitingDetection: The folder is ready. Detection results will appear here.

workspaceDialogs.editTip2: If you need a different folder, remove this record and add the game again.
workspaceDialogs.folderMappingHint: Folder mappings keep the source folder name by default. For example, XMenu -> modloader becomes modloader/XMenu/*.
